from harness import *
import json
fails=[]
def chk(label, got, want):
    if got != want: fails.append("%s: got %r want %r"%(label,got,want))
def dec(r):
    if r["status"]=="reject": return "reject:"+r["reason"]
    return "accept:%s:%s:priv=%s"%(r["identity"],r["basis"],r["private"])
L=lambda s="session-k":{"kind":"local","subject":s}
P=lambda n="edge":{"kind":"peer","name":n}
U={"kind":"untrusted"}

def J(gw,ing,to,**kw):
    j={"gateway":gw,"ingress":ing,"trusted_out":to}
    j.update(kw)
    return j

# chain: local private (trusted_out) -> peer -> peer(untrusted_out) -> peer(no PAI -> unauth)
jobs=[
 J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=req(privacy="id")),
 J("inside",P("edge"),True,source=0),
 J("inside",P("edge"),False,source=1),
 J("inside",P("edge"),True,source=2),
 J("inside",P("edge"),True,source=99),
 J("inside",P("edge"),True,source=3),
]
res=run(jobs)
chk("hop0",dec(res[0]),"accept:sip:ember@studio.test:local:priv=True")
chk("hop1",dec(res[1]),"accept:sip:ember@studio.test:peer:priv=True")
chk("hop2",dec(res[2]),"accept:sip:ember@studio.test:peer:priv=True")
chk("hop3",dec(res[3]),"reject:unauthenticated")   # hop2 dropped PAI
chk("hop4 bad source",dec(res[4]),"reject:upstream")
chk("hop5 after reject",dec(res[5]),"reject:upstream")
chk("hop2 wire has no PAI","P-Asserted-Identity" in res[2]["wire"],False)
chk("hop1 == hop2 wire", res[1]["wire"]==res[2]["wire"], True)

# chain into a local ingress (forwarded text re-enters as a local endpoint claim)
jobs=[
 J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=req()),
 J("edge",L("session-k"),True,source=0),
 J("edge",L("solo"),True,source=0),
 J("narrow",L("session-k"),True,source=0),
 J("inside",L("session-k"),True,source=0),
]
res=run(jobs)
chk("re-local same acct",dec(res[1]),"accept:sip:ember@studio.test:local:priv=False")
chk("re-local other acct",dec(res[2]),"reject:identity")
chk("re-local narrow",dec(res[3]),"accept:sip:ember@studio.test:local:priv=False")
chk("re-local inside(no domains)",dec(res[4]),"reject:identity")

# forwarded text with private From re-entering local ingress -> anonymous From -> primary selected
jobs=[
 J("edge",L("session-k"),False,raw=req(privacy="id")),
 J("edge",L("session-k"),True,source=0),
]
res=run(jobs)
chk("anon re-local",dec(res[1]),"accept:sip:ember@studio.test:local:priv=True")
chk("anon re-local wire",res[1]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1],"From: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=q7")

# body round trip incl CRLFCRLF and header-looking text
body='line1\r\n\r\nFrom: <sip:evil@studio.test>\r\nX: y\r\n\tend'
jobs=[J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=req(body=body)),J("inside",P("edge"),True,source=0)]
res=run(jobs)
chk("body preserved",res[0]["wire"].endswith("\r\n\r\n"+body),True)
chk("body hop2",dec(res[1]),"accept:sip:ember@studio.test:peer:priv=False")
chk("body hop2 same",res[1]["wire"]==res[0]["wire"],True)

# growth: a request whose normalization grows (long CSeq zeros / big display names) beyond 32768?
big_body = "z"*32000
jobs=[J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=req(body=big_body)),J("edge",L("session-k"),True,source=0)]
res=run(jobs)
chk("big body hop0",res[0]["status"],"accept")
chk("big body hop1 len",len(res[0]["wire"])>32768,True)
chk("big body hop1",dec(res[1]),"reject:syntax")

# upstream referencing a syntax rejection
jobs=[J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=req(callid="bad id")),J("edge",L("session-k"),True,source=0)]
res=run(jobs)
chk("syntax then upstream",dec(res[1]),"reject:upstream")

# self reference / backward only
jobs=[J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=req()),J("edge",L("session-k"),True,source=1)]
res=run(jobs)
chk("forward source",dec(res[1]),"reject:upstream")

# tags survive hops
jobs=[J("edge",L("session-k"),True,raw=req(tag="AbC-1_.~",to_tag="z9")),J("inside",P("edge"),True,source=0)]
res=run(jobs)
chk("tags hop0",res[0]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1:3],["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=AbC-1_.~","To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>;tag=z9"])
chk("tags hop1",res[1]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1:3],["From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=AbC-1_.~","To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>;tag=z9"])

for f in fails: print("FAIL",f)
print("failures:",len(fails))
